purpose: Final diagnostic dataset before freezing experimentation.
hard_requirements: Question should not be safely answerable from generic knowledge or question wording alone.
At least some cases must require synthesis across two or more documents.
At least some cases must contain plausible distractor evidence.
At least some cases must be sensitive to evidence ordering.
Include at least one genuine missing-evidence control.
Do not modify production retrieval or generation code.
Do not use LLM calls while constructing or screening the dataset.
